codeBlocks:
Set up Higgsfield for me so I can generate images and videos from here.
1. Install the CLI: run `npm i -g @higgsfield/cli`.
2. Authenticate: run `higgsfield auth login` and complete the sign-in in the browser it opens.
3. Install the companion skills: run `npx skills add higgsfield-ai/skills`.
Once that’s done, let me know when it’s ready.

demos.label: Generate video
demos.title: Generate a video
demos.prompt: @Higgsfield Make a 14-second video of a young woman with dark hair in a pixie cut, wearing a green crop top and a grey midi skirt. She walks in slow motion through a busy vintage office. The camera tracks alongside her as papers fly through the air. Dim, green-tinted lighting creates a moody, cinematic atmosphere. She stops at a desk and answers a ringing black rotary phone with a serious expression.

demos.label: Generate image
demos.title: Generate an image
demos.prompt: @Higgsfield Create a fashion editorial photo of a young woman standing between pink architectural frames against lime-green walls, her hands resting on the vertical beams. She wears a sculptural ivory gown with floral ruffles, pearl detailing, and a layered skirt, her black hair styled into two exceptionally long braids with a flower beside her temple. Use soft studio lighting, saturated colors, and the natural grain of 35mm film.

demos.label: Edit a photo
demos.title: Edit a photo
demos.prompt: @Higgsfield Edit my photo: replace the oversized lavender music player and studio background with a grassy ledge overlooking rolling green hills beneath a pale blue sky. Swap the giant disc and headphones for a quilted pink backpack with a fluffy pom-pom and a pink water bottle with a cream cap. Use soft natural daylight and realistic contact shadows, keeping my face, pose, hair, outfit, white sneakers, and camera framing exactly the same.
